summary: Trio Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K to update its at-the-market (ATM) offering program under its existing S-3 shelf. The filing details serial amendments to the prospectus supplement, adjusting the amount of common stock available for sale under General Instruction I.B.6. The maximum aggregate offering was increased to $17,377,000, with $13,376,774 already sold. This is a routine capital-raising activity, not a special situation. No tender, merger, activist, or restructuring event is present. The filing discloses ordinary equity sales through an agent, Ladenburg Thalmann, with no specified terms beyond aggregate dollar amounts.
